{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows positive bias (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (e.g., 0.00 or -0.25).",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, delay peak price prediction by 1-2 days.",
    "Cap forecast overshoots above 10% above recent 5-day average if sentiment is neutral or positive.",
    "If sentiment history includes a recent +0.50, reduce forecast volatility and shift toward historical mean.",
    "When true outcome is consistently below forecast, apply a downward bias correction of 3-5% for next 3 days."
  ]
}
